definitions.short: a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy
definitions.usage: × exceedingly, gladness, × greatly, joy, rejoice(-ing), sort.
definitions.full: H1524. giyl I. גִּיל noun [masculine] rejoicing — Job 3:22 6 t., גִּו֯ל Prov 23:24 ; suffix גִּילִי Psa 43:4 ; — rejoicing 65:13 ; Prov 23:24 ; || שׂמחה Psa 45:16 ; Isa 16:10 ; Jer 48:33 ; Joel 1:16 , גִילִי שִׂמְחַת Psa 43:4 , גיל אל שׂמח glad unto rejoicing Hosea 9:1 ; Job 3:22 . II. [ גִּיל ] noun [masculine] circle, age , גִלְכֶם כְּ אשׁר הילדים מן of the youths which are of your age Dan 1:10 (compare Arabic Samaritan גיל = Hebrew דור = γενεά , Talmud גילו בן one born at the same time, a contemporary ).
